[Welcome!]{.welcome-text}

I am a final-year B.A. (Hons. with Research) Economics student and completing a minor in Mathematics at Ashoka University. 

My academic and research interests center on empirical questions within labour economics, development economics and firm dynamics. I am particularly drawn to the intersection of applied econometrics with data science and machine learning techniques to draw out causal insights from micro-level data. 

Throughout my undergraduate studies, I have balanced my coursework with research roles and projects spanning fieldwork and computational domains. Currently, I am working on my final-year thesis on the firm-level effects of Artificial Intelligence in India.

Work aside, I deeply enjoy reading modern history and philosophical texts, listening to and playing music across genres, and writing introspective long-form articles.
